description: This source file defines a SwiftUI wrapper for a WKWebView, managing its lifecycle, delegate handling, and communication between Swift and JavaScript via message handlers. It includes a UIViewRepresentable struct, a coordinator class managing WebView configuration, delegate classes for navigation handling, and message handling for JavaScript interactions.

classes.name: ScreenWebViewCoordinator
classes.description: Manages WKWebView lifecycle, delegates, and communication handlers for a ScreenController instance.

classes.name: ScreenNavigationDelegate
classes.description: Handles WKWebView navigation policies, intercepting custom URL schemes like 'openclaw://'.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: Handles messages from JavaScript to trigger actions in the ScreenController.

methods.name: makeContainerView
methods.description: Creates and configures the container UIView and WKWebView, setting up constraints and handlers.

methods.name: updateController
methods.description: Updates the controller reference and manages attaching/detaching the WKWebView accordingly.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Removes handlers, delegate references, and clears WKWebView and container views.

methods.name: makeWebView
methods.description: Instantiates a configured WKWebView with specific settings like non-persistent data store.

methods.name: installA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Adds JavaScript message handlers to the WKUserContentController.

methods.name: removeA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Removes message handlers from the WKUserContentController.
